items.exampleEn: This year's rice harvest was jeopardized by weeks of heavy rain.
items.exampleZh: 今年的稻米收成因為連續幾週的大雨而陷入危險。

items.exampleEn: The town prospered when the railway arrived.
items.exampleZh: 鐵路通車後，這個小鎮繁榮了起來。

items.exampleEn: The traffic worsens every Friday afternoon.
items.exampleZh: 每週五下午，交通都會變得更糟。

items.exampleEn: She overcame the handicap of a late start and still won the race.
items.exampleZh: 她克服了起步太慢的不利條件，最後還是贏了比賽。
items.glossZh: 不利條件；障礙（指身心障礙屬舊式用語）

items.exampleEn: The third flight delay caused unrest in the crowded waiting area.
items.exampleZh: 班機第三次延誤，讓擁擠的候機區騷動不安。

items.exampleEn: My friend's advice helped me get out of a difficult predicament.
items.exampleZh: 朋友的建議幫我擺脫了一個棘手的困境。

items.exampleEn: The singer's new album was overshadowed by news of his wedding.
items.exampleZh: 那位歌手的新專輯，被他結婚的新聞蓋過了鋒頭。

items.exampleEn: Scientists say average temperatures are rising globally.
items.exampleZh: 科學家說，全球的平均氣溫正在上升。

items.sentenceEn: Without more customers, the small shop will not prosper.
items.sentenceZh: 沒有更多顧客，這家小店是不會興旺的。

items.audioEn: Missing this deadline could jeopardize the whole project, so please work fast.
items.audioZh: 錯過這個截止日期可能會危及整個專案，所以請加快速度。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼要大家加快速度？
options: The office is going to close early this evening
Missing the deadline could hurt the project

items.sentenceEn: The rain worsened, so we decided to stay inside.
items.sentenceZh: 雨勢變大了，所以我們決定待在室內。

items.sentenceEn: Locked out of my apartment at midnight, I was in quite a predicament.
items.sentenceZh: 半夜被鎖在公寓外面，我陷入了窘境。

items.stemEn: Bad news about the economy ____ the good results of our sales team.
items.stemZh: 經濟的壞消息讓我們業務團隊的好成績黯然失色。

items.stemEn: Our company now has customers ____, from Brazil to Japan.
items.stemZh: 我們公司現在在全球都有顧客，從巴西到日本都有。

items.passageEn: Ten years ago, a small tea company in our town began to sell its products globally. At first, it prospered, but problems soon followed. Not having an English website was a handicap, and a fight between the two owners jeopardized the business. There was also some unrest among the workers, who felt their pay was unfair. As the situation worsened, the company found itself in a real predicament. A new manager finally solved the crucial problems: she built a new website and raised wages. Today, the company's success has overshadowed its difficult past.
items.passageZh: 十年前，我們鎮上一家小茶葉公司開始把產品銷往全球。起初生意很興旺，但問題很快就接踵而來。沒有英文網站是一項不利條件，兩位老闆之間的爭執也危及了公司。員工之間也出現了一些不滿，他們覺得薪水不公平。隨著情況惡化，公司真的陷入了困境。最後，一位新經理解決了關鍵的問題：她架設了新網站，也調高了工資。如今，公司的成功已經讓那段艱難的過去黯然失色。

questions.questionZh: 這家公司一開始遇到什麼不利條件？

options: 把公司賣給一家大型茶廠
把公司和工廠都搬到國外
架設新網站並調高工資

items.promptZh: 這個錯誤可能會危及我們和客戶的關係。
referenceEn: This mistake could jeopardize our relationship with the client.
This mistake may jeopardize our relationship with our client.
rubricZh: jeopardize 後面直接接受到危害的事物（例如 jeopardize our relationship）

items.promptZh: 這首歌在全世界都很有名。
referenceEn: This song is very famous globally.
The song is well known globally.
rubricZh: globally 表示「在全球」，可放形容詞後或句尾（例如 famous globally 等）
「很有名」可寫，例如 famous、well known、popular 等
